scope: Actual image review of all four final native renders against three previously actually viewed downloaded original photographs. No geometry edits made by this reviewer.

decision.summary_zh: 未见阻断建筑识别的重大可见形态错误；可交付为识别形态外观候选。长街窗网、精确柱式及雕饰仍明显简化，背部屋面和尺寸未经测绘，不构成完整照片复原或1917原貌验收。
decision.summary_en: No blocking visible morphology error remains for a recognition-oriented exterior candidate. This is not acceptance of a complete photo reconstruction, surveyed geometry, all elevations, or1917 original appearance.
conditions: Retain all authored size/height/step limits and source-frontage discrepancies.
Describe repetitive street modules and simplified classical ornament specifically.
Keep rear/roof and advertisement-covered walling marked estimated.
Keep1910s original form distinct from2010/2013/2024 multi-period photo references.
Do not use visual similarity as dimension calibration or as proof of exact structural floor counts.

bound_artifacts.receipt_limit: This reviewer independently inspected rendered images and file hashes; Blender reopen/mesh facts are taken from native.json, not independently rerun by the visual reviewer.

observations: Whole south-facing street body and southeast tower remain within frame. The untowered southwest chamfer is distinct from tower corner.

Ground arcade rhythm, lower two-layer tall window/column groups and stronger13m belt are visible. Group piers and upper rectangular windows remain much more repetitive than the photograph; this is a modular interpretation.
Broad closed roof in this elevated view is estimated, not a surveyed historic roof or proof of floor count.
Southeast tower correctly rises above the chamfered corner. Clock base, two reducing square/chamfered arched pavilions, circular lantern, shallow cap and slender rod are distinguishable.
Northeast lower wing is genuinely stepped below the high southwest body; large arched window rhythm appears along the lower east-facing wing. Exact step coordinates/height are estimates.
Plain upper corner infill beneath clock base stands for an unresolved advertisement-covered zone; it should not be described as verified original walling.
The same lower northeast roof step is visible from rear. No obvious detached terrace, inverted elevation or missing major roof surface is visible.
Rear windows, blank roof planes and inner vertical step wall are orderly estimated completions; the reference photos do not verify these elevations, roof interiors or courtyards.
Ground-through-finial corner detail is within frame. The large curved entrance pediment no longer visibly cuts through a row of upper windows; its backing panel is now plain stone.

Two lower square/chamfered pavilions have dark arched apertures and exterior columns; circular upper lantern is open-looking between columns. The visible clock base is correctly below these pavilions.

The entrance arch, projecting balcony and paired columns remain recognizable but their capitals, volutes, carved cartouche and mouldings are simplified and visually much less elaborate than2013/2024 photographs.
Clock dial/time and metalwork are schematic. No precise historical typography, contemporary advertising, original1917 pediments or reconstructed hidden advertising-zone windows are asserted.

observed_refinements_from_preliminary: Southeast large curved pediment has stone backing instead of cutting across the three-window row.
The limited south/west grouping treatment gives slightly stronger main belt and lower column/pier hierarchy; it does not remove the regular module-grid appearance.
A dedicated corner render now makes tower stages, entrance arch and unresolved blank advertisement zone inspectable.

material_limits.limit: Compared with2010 south/west photograph, long street window groups remain very regular; projecting piers, lower giant-column emphasis and horizontal cornice hierarchy are simplified. This is a material facade simplification, not merely missing weathering.
Ionic volutes, capitals, cartouches, reliefs, decorative ironwork and curved broken pediments are generalized; exact historic profiles are not reproduced.
2013 FANCL and2024 MIDO boards conceal upper southeast wall/roof edge. The model uses plain infill rather than evidence-based hidden windows. Omitting the boards does not reveal original geometry.
Back elevations, interior roof/possible courtyard arrangement, step transition distances and structural thicknesses remain estimated. The lower east wing is photo-guided only at gross form level.

100×68m authored body,30.6m high main roof,21.8m lower-wing roof and51.3m top including rod are design parameters. Sources give approximately66/61m street frontages and30余米 body text; no exact whole footprint or tower datum found. These quantities are not reconciled by visual review.
Reference photos capture2010,2013 and2024 states; upload date2026 is not capture date. Current tower changes and missing original pediments prevent labeling this a1917 reconstruction.
Pure-color material/light approximation omits patina, advertising, retail fittings and many small details. Native studio shadows are not a site-lighting study.
